'''Exo-technology''' was a field of [[Science/Legends|science]] that specialized in studying and combining the technologies of various [[Species/Legends|species]] of the galaxy. [[Tharan Cedrax]] was a exo-technologist who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]].
